name: Attributes
descr: What a buyer reads about a goods: the tree of the characteristics with its folders, and the values every one of them takes. The tree comes whole, the values are asked for by their characteristic - a live shop keeps thousands of them. The rights are a pair - the characteristic itself and its values - and they are given out on the characteristic, in the program.

commands.name: CmdListCut
commands.descr: Reads the tree of the characteristics and nothing beside it. The rights and the option rows come with CmdListFull; the values of a characteristic come with CmdValueList - a live shop keeps thousands of them.

commands.name: CmdListFull
commands.descr: Reads the tree of the characteristics together with the rights standing on them and the option rows set: three tables in one answer. The values are asked for by CmdValueList.

commands.name: CmdAdd
commands.descr: Adds a characteristic under a parent, or at the top of the tree when parent_id is 0. The rights of the parent are copied onto it.

params.name: parent_id
params.descr: id of the characteristic it goes under; 0 puts it at the top of the tree

params.name: skey
params.descr: the character key, unique among the characteristics

params.name: name
params.descr: the name a buyer reads

params.name: descr
params.descr: the description of the characteristic

params.name: folder
params.descr: true - a folder that only groups others, it holds no values itself

params.name: kind_key
params.descr: a value of INFO_KIND_KEY

params.name: type_key
params.descr: a value of INFO_TYPE_KEY - what it keeps: kSet a list of values, kDecimal a number, kText words of its own

params.name: in_topic
params.descr: true - it shows in the filters of a section

params.name: in_goods
params.descr: true - it shows on the card of a goods

params.name: seo_code
params.descr: the code of it in the address of a page

commands.descr: Changes the columns given of characteristics, by id - what the call leaves out stays as it was.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the characteristic, or several of them

params.name: skey
params.descr: the character key, unique among the characteristics

params.name: name
params.descr: the name a buyer reads

params.name: descr
params.descr: the description of the characteristic

params.name: kind_key
params.descr: a value of INFO_KIND_KEY

params.name: type_key
params.descr: a value of INFO_TYPE_KEY - what it keeps: kSet a list of values, kDecimal a number, kText words of its own

params.name: in_topic

commands.name: CmdMove
commands.descr: Moves a characteristic under another parent, with its whole branch.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the characteristic to move

params.name: parent_id
params.descr: id of the characteristic it goes under; 0 puts it at the top of the tree

commands.name: CmdRemove
commands.descr: Deletes characteristics by id, with the branch under them, their values and the links of the goods to those values. The first call counts what goes, the second one does it.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the characteristic, or several of them

params.name: depend
params.descr: true - the rows of the tables hanging on these go with them; without it such a deletion is refused

commands.name: CmdValueList
commands.descr: Reads the values of characteristics, or the values themselves by id. One of info_id and id is asked for: nothing answers every value of the shop.

params.name: info_id
params.descr: id of the characteristic, or several of them

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the value, or several of them

commands.name: CmdValueAdd
commands.descr: Adds a value to a characteristic, at the end of its list.

params.name: info_id
params.descr: id of the characteristic the value belongs to

params.name: skey
params.descr: the character key, unique among the values of this characteristic

params.name: name
params.descr: the value as a buyer reads it

params.name: descr
params.descr: the description of the value

params.name: kind_key
params.descr: a value of INFO_VALUE_KIND_KEY

params.name: params
params.descr: the parameters of the value, as the storefront reads them

params.name: seo_code
params.descr: the code of it in the address of a page

params.name: pos
params.descr: the place in the list of its characteristic; left out, it goes to the end

commands.name: CmdValueUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of values, by id - what the call leaves out stays as it was.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the value, or several of them

params.name: skey
params.descr: the character key, unique among the values of this characteristic

params.name: name
params.descr: the value as a buyer reads it

params.name: descr
params.descr: the description of the value

params.name: kind_key
params.descr: a value of INFO_VALUE_KIND_KEY

params.name: params
params.descr: the parameters of the value, as the storefront reads them

params.name: seo_code
params.descr: the code of it in the address of a page

params.name: pos
params.descr: the place in the list of its characteristic

commands.name: CmdValueRemove
commands.descr: Deletes values by id, with the links of the goods to them - the characteristic itself stays. The first call counts what goes, the second one does it.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the value, or several of them

params.name: depend
params.descr: true - the rows of the tables hanging on these go with them; without it such a deletion is refused

commands.name: CmdValuePos
commands.descr: Lays the values of one characteristic in order.

params.name: info_id
params.descr: id of the characteristic whose values are put in order

params.name: type
params.descr: POS - the rows given go to the front in that order; MOVE - one row shifts by so many places, minus upwards; SORT - the whole list is laid out by a column

params.name: data
params.descr: the payload of that type: [{"id": 22}] for POS, [{"id": 22, "inc": -5}] for MOVE - inc is how many places it shifts, minus upwards - and {"field": "name", "direction": "ASC"} for SORT

commands.name: CmdRightAdd
commands.descr: Grants a right on characteristics, to a person or to a group: one row of info_right on each of them. One of user_id and group_id, never both.

params.name: info_id
params.descr: id of the characteristic, or several of them

params.name: user_id
params.descr: id of the person the right belongs to

params.name: group_id
params.descr: id of the group the right belongs to

params.name: for_info
params.descr: true - the characteristic itself is theirs to shape

params.name: for_value
params.descr: true - the values of it are theirs to shape

commands.name: CmdRightUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of the rows of info_right, by id - CmdList answers them with their ids.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the row of info_right, or several of them

params.name: user_id
params.descr: id of the person the right belongs to

params.name: group_id
params.descr: id of the group the right belongs to

params.name: for_info
params.descr: true - the characteristic itself is theirs to shape

params.name: for_value
params.descr: true - the values of it are theirs to shape

commands.name: CmdRightRemove
commands.descr: Deletes the rows of info_right by id.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the row of info_right, or several of them

commands.name: CmdKeyAdd
commands.descr: Sets an option on characteristics: one row of info_key_set on each of them. The option and its value must stand in the tree of the characteristic options, and a stray id is refused.

params.name: info_id
params.descr: id of the characteristic, or several of them

params.name: key_id
params.descr: id of the option - the info_key table of CmdList answers them

params.name: value_id
params.descr: id of the value of that option, when it keeps a list of them - info_key_value of CmdList

params.name: value_txt
params.descr: the text of the value, when the option keeps its own words

commands.name: CmdKeyUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of the rows of info_key_set, by id - CmdList answers them with their ids. A row keeps whatever the call leaves out, and the pair it will stand with is weighed against the tree.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the row of info_key_set, or several of them

params.name: key_id
params.descr: id of the option - the info_key table of CmdList answers them

params.name: value_id
params.descr: id of the value of that option, when it keeps a list of them - info_key_value of CmdList

params.name: value_txt
params.descr: the text of the value, when the option keeps its own words

commands.name: CmdKeyRemove
commands.descr: Deletes the rows of info_key_set by id. The option itself stays in the registry.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the row of info_key_set, or several of them
